entities.name: User Equipment

entities.name: Sidelink Measurement Identity
entities.description: An identifier for a sidelink measurement configuration in the UE.

entities.description: Timer associated with periodic measurement reporting for a sidelink measurement identity.

entities.name: Sidelink Time To Trigger
entities.description: Time duration before a measurement report is triggered for sidelink.

entities.name: Sidelink Measurement Identity To Remove List
entities.description: List of sidelink measurement identities to be removed from UE configuration.

entities.name: Non-configured Sidelink Measurement Identity

relations.description: Stopping the periodical reporting timer for the specified sl-MeasId.
Resetting associated information like sl-TimeToTrigger for the specified sl-MeasId.
The removal list contains sl-MeasId values to be processed.
UE does not consider the message erroneous if removal list includes non-configured sl-MeasId values.
